flashvar.name: file
flashvar.description: Location of the HD video the player should load. The regular 'file' flashvar holds the location of the fallback video.

flashvar.name: fullscreen
flashvar.description: When "true", HD is automatically toggled on when switching to fullscreen.

flashvar.name: state
flashvar.description: Set this "false" to let the player start with the low-quality video. Set this "true" to let the player start with HD.
